data.name: Better Default Values
data.summary: Improves preset values across the game. Starting attributes for classes, spell selection, and more. Also changes the default subclass for Shadowheart and Wyll.

modfile.changelog:
Improved Death Domain cantrip priority so bone chill is prioritized over bursting sinew (affects Shadowheart)
Removed Intelligence attribute from high elf cantrip, will still be locked to your starting classes' spellcasting ability, but at least it will use that one rather than always Int
Fixed Command not being prepared automatically for clerics and added a few fallback spells in case you have higher Wisdom than 17 (for some reason)

data.name: Alchemy Better Descriptions
data.summary: The vanilla Alchemy interface only shows technical flavor text and doesn't explain what a Potion, Elixir, Coating or Grenade actually does. This mod adds clear, practical descriptions of each item's real purpose alongside the original text.

modfile.changelog: The tooltip now displays the DC (Difficulty Class) correctly.

data.name: Better Crusaders Mantle
data.summary: Crusader's Mantle now benefits from upcasting.

data.name: Better Second Wind
data.summary: Second Wind's healing value is now based on 2D8 + the character's Fighter Level multiplied by 3.

data.name: Better Fire Shield
data.summary: Both versions of Fire Shield now cost a Bonus Action instead of an Action. This extends to armor which gives these spells. Support added for upcasting past Spell Level 6, load after any mod which alters the max character level.

data.name: Better Dimension Door
data.summary: Dimension Door now only costs a Bonus Action. Supports upcasting up to Spell Level 9. Load after any mod which adds character levels beyond 12.

data.name: Better Bursting Sinew
data.summary: Bursting Sinew is now based on a Ranged Spell Attack Roll, rather than a Dex Save. In addition, the Piercing Damage it deals is now considered Magical, along with being able to be used on non-fresh corpses.

modfile.changelog: Bursting Sinew can now be used on 'damaged' corpses, such as a fire damaged corpse.

data.name: Better Sacred Flame
data.summary: Sacred Flame uses an Attack Roll instead of a Dexterity save. In addition, it deals an additional 1D4 radiant damage to fiends and undead.

modfile.changelog: Fixed the description values when LV5 or above.
